People
Meet the people behind Atomic.

Drasko Draskovic · Founder & CEO
Drasko Draskovic
Founder & CEO · Paris, France
Drasko Draskovic is the founder of Abstract Machines and the founder and CEO behind Atomic. A deep-tech entrepreneur and systems engineer, he brings more than 20 years of experience in IoT and cloud-computing systems. His background includes work at Texas Instruments, Alcatel-Lucent, Nokia, Sequans and Devialet. He co-founded Datapace with George Saleh as an internal venture at Nokia, where he served as CTO. His work spans open-source infrastructure and the identity, data and execution systems that support applications.
Short bio
Drasko Draskovic is the founder of Abstract Machines and the founder and CEO behind Atomic. He is a systems engineer and entrepreneur with more than 20 years of experience in IoT and cloud computing.
Interview topics
Taking an app from a plain-language idea through Canvas editing to a reviewed release.
Why application identity, permissions and data matter in AI app building.
Source visibility and open-source infrastructure.

Dusan Borovcanin
Technical leadership
Dusan Borovcanin is Tech Lead at Abstract Machines, with more than 10 years of experience in distributed systems. His work includes confidential-computing infrastructure for AI and the engineering foundations behind Atomic. He previously built cocos-ai alongside Drasko Draskovic at Ultraviolet.
George Saleh
Finance & Operations
George Saleh leads finance and operations for Atomic. He brings more than 27 years of technology-leadership experience spanning AI, blockchain, enterprise architecture and digital transformation. He co-founded Datapace with Drasko Draskovic as an internal venture at Nokia. His background includes Distinguished Member of Technical Staff standing at Nokia.
